note: Paraphrased public GaussIQ product concepts for this QA demo. Not their screenshots, CSS, or proprietary copy.

entries.title: Case Intelligence (public concept)
entries.summary: Public product idea: for one support case, recommend a likely root cause, next actions, verification, and the evidence (including knowledge you should ignore). This lab does not clone that UI. It stores AJ18991 as a fixture and runs named RCA rules.

entries.title: Skills Intelligence (public concept)
entries.summary: Public product idea: infer demonstrated skills, proficiency, and recency from closed work, then show coverage gaps. Human approval is called out before inferred skills become policy. This lab only lists fixture gaps — it does not infer skills from a model.

entries.title: Management Insights (public concept)
entries.summary: Public product idea: turn operational evidence into a ranked backlog of what to change (staffing, AI vs human split, broken resolution paths). This lab shows original MTTR / eng-assist fixtures for a demo tenant, not GaussIQ published outcome ranges.

entries.title: Connect signals (public concept)
entries.summary: Public how-it-works step: connect ticketing, knowledge, CRM, telemetry, and work history, then recommend an execution path. This lab mocks one ticketing connector as CrashLoopBackOff so Case Intelligence evidence goes stale.
